reviews.t: Lovely, soft scent - perfect for feet/hands!
reviews.x: I am very particular and sensitive to scents.  I love this scent - it lasts and lasts!  I apply the creamy "concreta" to my hands/cuticles and even my feet and I love how they smell so good.  I wish it came in a larger size!

Though it may not look like a lot, a little goes a long way.  I use daily on my elbows and just love the results.  Not only is the fragrance subtle, the balm soaks right in and keeps my skin soft all day.  I use a small makeup spoon to scrap a little bit out since it has a slightly firm consistency (similar to coconut oil).  It feels slightly granular when applying, however, that quickly disappears, like it's melting into your skin, leaving it soft.  The container is made from hand-carved soapst

I get more compliments on this scent then any I have ever worn. It is steamy and sexy and mysterious and I love it. People tell me they can tell where I have been because the scent lingers and not in a bad way. I had an office fling a few years ago and I still get messages that say "I got on the elevator and I smelled you and it drove me crazy". I like that. People ask what it is and I tell them it is my secret. My sister gave me a concreta for Christmas one year and I actually thought it smelle

reviews.t: Scent doesn’t last and is still expensive!
reviews.x: I tried this at a spa in San Antonio and the scent would last most of the day. This doesn’t last an hour. For the price I paid I’m beyond disappointed! Don’t order this for the scent
Product itself is nice,  but it arrived in a paper bubble envelope that was not enough to protect the stone casing. It arrived cracked and chipped. Had to return it.

reviews.t: I wanted it for the aroma, but the scent ...
reviews.x: I wanted it for the aroma, but the scent is too faint. It also leaves a greasy feel on the hands which is expected for a balm I guess, but just FYI.

reviews.t: Love the product not the broken lid
reviews.x: Love the product but lid was in pieces. Container was wrapped in bubble wrap. Not worth the money without the pretty container.
Wonderful product!  I adore this scent and it is a superior moisturizer for my nails,

I originally found this product in a boutique over 20 years ago - the scent is the ORE is divine and I've purchased it dozens of time since then- for myself and gifts for others. I recently scraped my forearm and was worried about scars. As soon as the wound healed, I started putting this balm on every night. 3 days later all of the scabs have softened and it looks SO much better!! Now I have another use for this amazing product that I love. I wish I could become a spokesperson!! Can't say enoug

This stuff is the best but I wish I bought the sample pack first then I could think of how to layer the scents and what mixes I could do . I like sun + petal + pear  , I find since the scent in the concreta last longer I have to add the others on later to freshen up . If you want to find out mixes go on the zents homepage look under attar ( just pick any scent )  then  tips

reviews.t: Hard to get out of jar, difficult to apply to skin.
reviews.x: This product although advertised as a balm, doesn't feel like it.  It feels like wax. It's difficult to apply to your skin as it doesn't spread or absorb like a cream would.  It's a very unpleasant experience.  I can't get it out of the container without a struggle and applying to skin feels terrible. Too bad because the scent is wonderful.

THIS WAS A WASTE OF MONEY ($53.50).  YOU ARE MOSTLY PAYING FOR THE CERAMIC CONTAINER.  THE SALVE IS OILY AND HAS A PUNGENT ODOR (EARTH SCENT) WHICH IS ANNOYING.  I WASHED IT OFF OF MY HANDS AFTER ENDURING THE OFFENSIVE SMELL FOR 30 MINS.  YOU DON'T ALWAYS GET WHAT YOU PAY FOR, THIS IS ONE EXAMPLE OF SUCH.  IN THE TRASH IT GOES!

This product was introduced to me by a local Beauty Spa. I just absolutely fall in love with the scent. I usually place a dab or two behind my ear, use it like a perfume product. This scent is so perfect pairing with my yoga practice.

I’m sure this is a great product and that’s why I gave it five stars. The problem is that strong scented items give me a headache and that is why I had to return it. It smells good but it wasn’t good for me.
This is a great scent for men or women. Go easy applying; it is long lasting and has lots of different notes as the time goes on. So happy I found it again.
Got this as a gift YEARS AGO... decided to finally buy my own.  Was shocked that I basically bought a $50+ ceramic jar.... hardly any product.

reviews.t: No!  Pretty box.  Wife never touched it!
reviews.x: Give your beloved cash instead.  She will also not remember it, but it won't sit on your bathroom sink for 5 years, never seeing use.

reviews.t: Great, Could not find anywhere else
reviews.x: This is a great product, and it has a nice smell.  Use it on your hands daily for smoother looking skin and soften your cuticles.

reviews.t: Great for cuticles and cracked heals
reviews.x: This is the all time best for feet, especially dry cracked heels, cuticles, elbows, knees. After every day use on cracked heels for about a week you can cut back to about 3 times a week, then finally once a week to maintain.This is awesome stuff and the fragrance is divine. Found this little gem at a spa in Colorado Springs and happy that Amazon carries it.

Bought this for the first time in a spa and was instantly hooked! It's amazing! The Petal scent is little sweet but in a delicate way, not overwhelming. Every time I use it my husband always tells me how good I smell.  You can't go wrong with any of the scents they're all beautiful and the container is an added bonus. I highly recommend it.

I bought the Earth scent several years ago at a shoppe while on vacation. It lasted a long time and I recently bought the same scent on Amazon. Unfortunately they changed the formulation and it is not the same even though the name, Earth, is the same. Very disappointing. I already opened it and that is how I realized.

reviews.t: Great product - will get different scent next time
reviews.x: I love the feel of this - it's really sheer and silky. It feels nice and "melts" really nicely.  Thee scent lasts several hours, which I really like.  I have this fig scent in the body wash and I love it - in this product it's too musky and quite overwhelming.  I'll buy again but definitely not this scent.
I use this as a hair balm. It smooths fly aways and smells so good.  Only takes a little bit however or it will weigh your hair down.  I love this stuff even if it is a littel bit pricy.

claims.text: Many reviewers love the scent, describing it as long-lasting, subtle, and compliment-worthy.
Some reviewers find the scent too faint or short-lived, especially for the price.
Several reviewers report the balm is hard, waxy, or greasy and difficult to get out of the jar and apply.
Multiple reviewers received the product with a cracked or broken container due to inadequate packaging.
Reviewers praise the product as a high-quality, effective moisturizer where a little goes a long way.
